# Monitoring and Alerting Scripts

Automating webhook notifications to Slack / Discord on incident detection:

```bash
send_alert() {
    local msg="$1"
    curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --data "{\"text\":\"$msg\"}" "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"
}
```
